Plot pseudotime as a colour gradient on a 2D embedding

Source: R/aspis_trajectory.R
ASPIS_plot_pseudotime.Rd

Colours cells by their Monocle3 pseudotime value on a UMAP or tSNE embedding. Cells with NA pseudotime (those in partitions without a root) are drawn in na_colour.

Usage

ASPIS_plot_pseudotime(
  sce,
  dimred = NULL,
  pseudotime_col = "monocle_pseudotime",
  na_colour = "grey80",
  palette = NULL,
  point_size = 0.5,
  point_alpha = 0.7,
  title = NULL
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment with pseudotime results from TRIPODES_run_monocle.

dimred

Character. Embedding to plot on. NULL (default) uses the embedding recorded in metadata(sce)$monocle_dimred; otherwise specify any name present in reducedDimNames(sce).

pseudotime_col

Character. colData column containing pseudotime values. Default "monocle_pseudotime".

na_colour

Character. Colour for cells with NA pseudotime. Default "grey80".

palette

Character vector of colours for the gradient, or NULL for viridis (default).

point_size

Numeric. Cell point size. Default 0.5.

point_alpha

Numeric. Cell point opacity. Default 0.7.

title

Character or NULL. Plot title.

Value

A ggplot object.
